        self.assertEqual(durations.parse_duration("0h0m0s"), 0)
        self.assertEqual(durations.parse_duration("100h"), 360000)

        self.assertEqual(durations.parse_duration("45s  "), 45)

        self.assertEqual(durations.parse_duration("\t2h5s\n"), 7205)
